title: Vrbo Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vrbo:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for vrbo metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for vrbo metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It combines the smoothed week-long trend in your value from vrbo metric1 (1).
